title: Dynamic Early Exit in Reasoning Models
authors_zh: Chenxu Yang、Qingyi Si、Yongjie Duan、Zheliang Zhu、Chenyu Zhu、Qiaowei Li、Minghui Chen、Zheng Lin、Weiping Wang
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计推理轨迹、反馈契约、选择机制与复现边界的读者
one_line: DEER probes trial answers at reasoning transitions and exits when model self-confidence is high, while the official repository releases only part of the paper's implementation and no reusable rollout corpus.
DEER 在推理的转折处试探性给出答案，当模型自信度足够高时提前退出；官方仓库只发布了论文实现的一部分，且没有可复用的采样语料。
why: It makes adaptive trace truncation auditable as a sequence of transition detection, answer induction, confidence estimation, and branch selection rather than treating reduced benchmark token counts as data-quality evidence.
inclusion_reason: A model-internal trace selector that turns transition events, trial answers, and self-confidence into an explicit test-time exit decision with concrete calibration and replay risks.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Long-chain reasoning can continue after a model has accumulated enough information to answer. The additional tokens increase latency and memory use, and later reasoning may overturn a correct intermediate result. Static token budgets cannot place the cutoff per example: easy and difficult problems, or even different reasoning paths for the same problem, can reach a sufficient prefix at different points.

Dynamic Early Exit in Reasoning Models asks whether the model can identify such a point online without extra training. For this atlas, the relevant object is not a new training dataset. It is an inference-time decision trace containing the original prompt, current CoT prefix, detected transition event, induced trial-answer branch, token probabilities, aggregated self-confidence, exit-or-continue action, final answer, and external benchmark outcome. The benchmark outcome evaluates the controller; it is not a quality label for every prefix.

长链推理可能在模型已经积累足够答题信息后仍继续生成。额外 token 会增加延迟和显存占用，后续推理还可能推翻一个原本正确的中间结果。固定 token 预算无法为每个样本确定合适截断点：简单题与困难题，甚至同一问题的不同推理路径，都可能在不同位置达到信息充分的前缀。

《Dynamic Early Exit in Reasoning Models》研究模型能否在无需额外训练的情况下在线识别这一位置。在本图谱中，相关对象不是新训练数据集，而是一条推理时决策轨迹：原始 prompt、当前 CoT 前缀、检测到的转折事件、诱导出的试答分支、token 概率、聚合后的自置信度、退出或继续动作、最终答案，以及外部 benchmark 结果。Benchmark 结果用于评估控制器，不能作为每个前缀的质量标签。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
DEER is a training-free controller with three operations. A reasoning transition monitor marks possible exit points either from linguistic action-transition points such as Wait and Alternatively, or from high entropy at a reasoning-step boundary. An answer inducer temporarily appends an end-of-thinking/final-answer cue and asks the same model for a boxed trial answer. A confidence evaluator takes the maximum predicted probability at each trial-answer token and aggregates multi-token answers with a geometric mean. If confidence exceeds λ, the controller terminates thinking; otherwise it discards the trial branch and resumes from the saved prefix.

DEER-PRo performs several answer inductions with varied prompts, then subtracts a Mean Absolute Deviation-based fluctuation penalty from mean confidence to reduce prompt-noise false exits. The paper also describes Branch-Parallel Decoding: trial branches and continued reasoning are linearized under a special causal mask, then dynamic KV-cache pruning removes branches based on confidence. These components select inference branches; none supplies independent correctness verification.

DEER 是包含三个操作的无训练控制器。Reasoning transition monitor 通过 Wait、Alternatively 等语言动作转折点，或推理步骤边界处的高熵，标记候选退出位置。Answer inducer 临时追加结束思考/最终答案提示，让同一个模型生成 boxed 试答。Confidence evaluator 取每个试答 token 的最大预测概率，并用几何平均聚合多 token 答案。若置信度超过 λ，控制器终止思考；否则丢弃试答分支，从保存的前缀继续推理。

DEER-PRo 使用多种 prompt 进行多次答案诱导，再从平均置信度中减去基于 Mean Absolute Deviation 的波动惩罚，以降低 prompt 噪声导致的错误早退。论文还描述 Branch-Parallel Decoding：利用特殊 causal mask，把试答分支与继续推理线性化并行生成，再通过动态 KV-cache 管理按置信度裁剪分支。这些组件选择的是推理分支；它们都不提供独立正确性验证。

title: Method
方法
html:
At generation time, marker-based DEER watches action-transition tokens. Entropy-based DEER instead treats blank-line-delimited reasoning steps as units, measures the entropy of the next step's initial token, and uses values above the reported 0.672 threshold as candidates. At each candidate, the current prefix is forked. The inducing branch uses a final-answer cue and extracts a boxed answer, while the original branch is retained so decoding can continue after a low-confidence trial. The reported default confidence threshold is 0.95; the paper studies 0.9-0.97, but also notes that some models with systematically low confidence require a lower threshold.

The paper evaluates 11 reasoning models across GSM8K, MATH-500, AMC 2023, AIME 2024, AIME 2025, OlympiadBench, GPQA Diamond, HumanEval, BigCodeBench, and LiveCodeBench. Main correctness runs use zero-shot CoT, greedy decoding, one sample, rule-based answer checks or Pass@1, and a 16,384-token maximum. AMC/AIME results use repeated rounds because of small sample counts. Supplementary Qwen3 experiments also test the recommended 32,768-token, top-p 0.95, temperature 0.6 configuration. These are evaluation settings, not a released trace schema.

The official MIT repository provides Hugging Face Transformers and vLLM implementations for mathematical reasoning and rule-based evaluation on seven benchmarks. Its Qwen3 path changes confidence aggregation and additionally requires the trial branch to generate the closing think tag before exit. The repository states that code-generation support and Branch-Parallel Decoding Acceleration are still coming soon, has no tagged release, and does not publish a versioned corpus of CoTs, candidate transitions, trial branches, confidence sequences, or exit decisions.

生成时，marker-based DEER 监视动作转折 token。Entropy-based DEER 则把空行分隔的推理步骤作为单元，测量下一步骤首 token 的熵，并把超过论文所报 0.672 阈值的位置作为候选点。每到一个候选点，系统分叉当前前缀：诱导分支加入最终答案提示并提取 boxed 答案；原分支继续保留，以便试答置信度不足时恢复解码。论文默认置信阈值为 0.95，并研究 0.9-0.97 区间；同时也指出，对持续低置信的特定模型需要降低阈值。

论文在 GSM8K、MATH-500、AMC 2023、AIME 2024、AIME 2025、OlympiadBench、GPQA Diamond、HumanEval、BigCodeBench 和 LiveCodeBench 上评估 11 个推理模型。主要正确性实验采用 zero-shot CoT、greedy decoding、单样本、规则答案检查或 Pass@1，以及 16,384 token 上限。由于样本较少，AMC/AIME 结果使用重复轮次。补充 Qwen3 实验还测试 32,768 token、top-p 0.95、temperature 0.6 的推荐配置。这些是评估设置，不是已发布轨迹 schema。

官方 MIT 仓库提供数学推理的 Hugging Face Transformers 与 vLLM 实现，以及七个 benchmark 的规则评估。其 Qwen3 路径改变置信度聚合，并额外要求试答分支生成 think 结束标签后才能退出。仓库明确说明代码生成支持与 Branch-Parallel Decoding Acceleration 仍为 coming soon，也没有 tagged release；当前未发布包含 CoT、候选转折、试答分支、置信序列和退出决策的版本化语料。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across the paper's evaluated model-task combinations, DEER changes both generated-token count and final-answer accuracy. The final ICLR version reports aggregate length reductions of 19.1%-80.1% and accuracy changes of +0.3 to +5.0 points; main-table comparisons also show that DEER-PRo can trade a small amount of extra generation for more robust accuracy on some smaller models. Threshold ablations show that a low threshold can produce premature incorrect exits, while an overly high threshold exits late. Latency experiments distinguish token reduction from wall-clock gains and report additional benefit from the paper's branch-parallel design.

These results support studying confidence-gated early exit under the reported models, prompts, and evaluators. They do not show that the confidence is calibrated on each domain, that the chosen prefix contains faithful reasoning, or that raw decision traces are reusable data. The released repository is narrower than the paper: mathematical Hugging Face/vLLM code is available under MIT, while the README still marks code-generation and branch-parallel code as forthcoming and provides no rollout release. Benchmark gains therefore cannot be used as proof of trace quality or artifact completeness.

在论文评估的模型—任务组合中，DEER 同时改变生成 token 数与最终答案准确率。ICLR 最终版本报告总体长度降低 19.1%-80.1%，准确率变化为 +0.3 到 +5.0 个百分点；主表还显示，在部分小模型上，DEER-PRo 会用少量额外生成换取更稳健的准确率。阈值消融表明，过低阈值会产生错误早退，过高阈值则退出过晚。延迟实验区分 token 减少与实际 wall-clock 收益，并报告论文所述 branch-parallel 设计带来的额外收益。

这些结果支持在所报告模型、prompt 与 evaluator 下研究置信门控早退，但不能证明置信度在每个领域都已校准，也不能证明所选前缀包含忠实推理或原始决策轨迹可作为数据复用。公开仓库的范围小于论文：数学任务的 Hugging Face/vLLM 代码采用 MIT 发布，而 README 仍把代码生成与 branch-parallel 代码标为待发布，也没有 rollout release。因此，benchmark 提升不能作为轨迹质量或 artifact 完整性的证据。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Fixed budget forcing ends reasoning at a predetermined length, while repeated-answer baselines stop after outputs stabilize at periodic probes. DEER instead uses model-state-dependent candidate points and the probabilities of an induced answer. Its data-facing contribution is an explicit selection record linking a semantic or entropy transition, temporary answer branch, token confidences, aggregation rule, threshold, branch pruning, and final outcome. DEER-PRo adds repeated prompt-conditioned measurements and a dispersion penalty.

Early exit, confidence thresholding, entropy monitoring, prompt ensembles, and KV-cache pruning are not individually new. The direction signal is their composition around a long-CoT branch decision without training a new policy. Because the same model generates the reasoning, trial answer, and confidence signal, the method remains self-assessment rather than an external verifier or reward contract.

固定 budget forcing 在预定长度终止推理；重复答案类基线则定期探测，并在输出稳定后停止。DEER 改用依赖模型当前状态的候选点，以及诱导答案的概率。其数据侧贡献是定义显式选择记录，把语义或熵转折、临时答案分支、token 置信度、聚合规则、阈值、分支裁剪与最终结果连接起来。DEER-PRo 进一步加入受不同 prompt 条件影响的重复测量和离散度惩罚。

早退、置信阈值、熵监视、prompt ensemble 与 KV-cache pruning 单独来看都不是新技术。该工作的方向信号是：在不训练新策略的前提下，把它们组合成长 CoT 分支决策。由于推理、试答和置信信号都来自同一个模型，该方法仍是自我评估，而不是外部 verifier 或 reward contract。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
The central assumption is that trial-answer token probability tracks answer correctness. This can fail under distribution shift, for models with systematically low or inflated confidence, and for long structured code answers. Qwen3 required implementation-specific changes, directly showing that one aggregation and exit predicate does not transfer unchanged. DEER-PRo reduces prompt dispersion but does not create independent ground truth.

Marker monitoring is English- and model-dependent; equivalent transition tokens must be found in other languages. Entropy peaks indicate uncertainty about the next token, not necessarily a semantic reasoning boundary. A confident wrong prefix can exit early, while a correct but low-confidence prefix can waste compute. Truncation can also make the visible rationale incomplete or unfaithful to the returned answer.

Trial branches add compute, latency, and KV-cache overhead, especially for code. Branch-parallel acceleration changes scheduling and memory behavior, but its official code is not yet released. Main experiments often use greedy decoding and a 16k cap; behavior under stochastic sampling, other token budgets, closed models, tools, or open-ended outputs remains incompletely established.

No versioned decision-trace dataset is documented. Raw prefixes, all candidate events, rejected trial answers, token probabilities, thresholds, branch timing, failures, seeds, exact run manifests, and per-example exit logs are unavailable as a stable release. Code has no tagged release. Benchmark accuracy and compression cannot substitute for calibration, replay, contamination, or trace-faithfulness audits.

核心假设是试答 token 概率能够反映答案正确性。该假设可能在分布迁移、持续低置信或过度自信的模型，以及长结构化代码答案上失效。Qwen3 需要实现特定修改，直接说明同一聚合方法与退出判定不能原样迁移。DEER-PRo 能降低 prompt 离散，但不会产生独立 ground truth。

Marker 监视依赖英语与模型，其他语言必须重新寻找等价转折 token。熵峰表示模型对下一 token 不确定，不一定对应语义推理边界。自信但错误的前缀可能过早退出，正确但低置信的前缀则可能浪费算力。截断还可能使可见 rationale 不完整，或与返回答案不忠实。

试答分支会增加计算、延迟与 KV-cache 开销，代码任务尤其明显。Branch-parallel acceleration 改变调度和显存行为，但官方尚未发布其代码。主要实验通常使用 greedy decoding 与 16k 上限；对随机采样、其他 token 预算、闭源模型、工具使用或开放式输出的行为仍未充分建立。

目前没有版本化决策轨迹数据集。原始前缀、全部候选事件、被拒试答、token 概率、阈值、分支时序、失败、seed、精确运行清单与逐样本退出日志都没有稳定发布；代码也没有 tagged release。Benchmark 准确率和压缩率不能替代校准、回放、污染或轨迹忠实性审计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the rollout_search_test_time_trace_data track, DEER supplies a schema for adaptive-compute trace selection. An auditable record should retain the benchmark item and split, model and tokenizer revision, full unmodified CoT, every marker or entropy candidate, saved prefix state, inducing prompt, trial tokens and per-token probabilities, aggregation method, λ, DEER-PRo mean/MAD terms, branch timing and memory, exit action, final answer, external correctness, and the corresponding full-decoding outcome.

Such records could support calibration of false exits and missed exits, imitation of compute controllers, comparative test-time-compute studies, or construction of preference pairs between truncated and continued traces. Reuse must keep model self-confidence, controller decision, benchmark correctness, rationale faithfulness, and actual latency as separate fields. The current code can help reproduce part of the controller, but absent rollout logs and branch-parallel code prevent claiming a complete reusable release.

对 rollout_search_test_time_trace_data 轨道而言，DEER 提供了自适应算力轨迹选择 schema。可审计记录应保留 benchmark 样本与 split、模型和 tokenizer revision、未修改的完整 CoT、每个 marker 或 entropy 候选点、保存的前缀状态、诱导 prompt、试答 token 与逐 token 概率、聚合方法、λ、DEER-PRo 的均值/MAD 项、分支时序与显存、退出动作、最终答案、外部正确性，以及对应的完整解码结果。

这类记录可以用于校准错误早退与漏退、模仿算力控制器、比较 test-time compute，或构造截断轨迹与继续轨迹之间的偏好对。复用时必须把模型自置信度、控制器决策、benchmark 正确性、rationale 忠实性和实际延迟保存为不同字段。当前代码可用于复现部分控制器，但缺少 rollout 日志与 branch-parallel 代码，不能声称存在完整可复用发布。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Data object: CoT prefix, transition candidate, induced trial answer, token probabilities, confidence aggregation, and exit decision.
  • The gate is the target model's self-confidence, not an independent correctness verifier.
  • Main experiments use λ = 0.95, greedy decoding, and a 16,384-token cap; entropy-based candidates use a reported 0.672 threshold.
  • DEER-PRo penalizes confidence dispersion across inducing prompts; branch-parallel decoding is described in the paper.
  • Official MIT code covers mathematical Hugging Face/vLLM paths, but rollout data, code-generation support, and branch-parallel code remain unreleased.

• 数据对象：CoT 前缀、转折候选点、诱导试答、token 概率、置信聚合与退出决策。
  • 门控信号来自目标模型自身置信度，不是独立正确性 verifier。
  • 主要实验使用 λ = 0.95、greedy decoding 和 16,384 token 上限；基于 entropy 的候选点采用论文所报 0.672 阈值。
  • DEER-PRo 惩罚不同诱导 prompt 间的置信离散；论文还描述 branch-parallel decoding。
  • 官方 MIT 代码覆盖数学任务的 Hugging Face/vLLM 路径，但 rollout 数据、代码生成支持和 branch-parallel 代码仍未发布。
